Enum Class WorkoutMetric

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<WorkoutMetric>
com.kineticfitness.model.WorkoutMetric
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<WorkoutMetric>, Constable
public enum WorkoutMetric extends Enum<WorkoutMetric>
A measurable quantity of a logged workout, and the figures a statistics screen reports about it.

Each constant knows how to read itself off a Workout, so adding a third measure means adding a constant here rather than extending a conditional in whatever screen happens to draw the chart. The aggregates are defined once in terms of of(Workout) and inherited by every constant.

Workout duration is deliberately absent: a workout records its date and its exercises' sets and reps, and nothing in the app stores how long it took.

US-13 — Track goal progress.
